text: Server admin: confirm before resetting a user's password; the new password is selectable and has a Copy button (both clients)

Also (maintainer): the change-password form (Android Account screen; web Settings page) gets a third field 'New password (again)'; a mismatch shows the inline error 'The passwords do not match.' under it and sends nothing. Nine locales on both clients, identical English.

On main (7c6fc586) as two cherry-picked commits, full gate green (app 779, web 604): reset confirmation naming the user after the step-up check; selectable password + Copy ('Copied!' reused); 'New password (again)' with a client-only mismatch check on both clients, request body unchanged.
